faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Quick answers about our products, your orders, and the initiative behind them.
faq.meta_description: Answers to common questions about Made With Determination products, orders, delivery and returns.
faq.a1: A national initiative by the Public Security Directorate that lets residents of Jordan's Reform & Rehabilitation Centers sell the crafts they make by hand — every purchase supports their rehabilitation and reintegration.
faq.a2: Residents of the centers, trained by specialized instructors, craft every piece by hand from carefully selected materials.
faq.a3: Yes. This is an official government platform and all payments are processed over a secure, encrypted connection.
faq.a4: Orders are usually delivered within 3–5 business days across Jordan. You can follow your order any time from “Track an order”.
faq.q5: Can I return or exchange an item?
faq.a5: Unused items in their original condition can be returned or exchanged within 14 days of delivery. See Delivery & returns for details.
faq.a6: 100% of proceeds go toward rehabilitating the makers and helping them reintegrate into society with dignity.

about.hero_title: Made with Determination — when willpower becomes a product
about.hero_body: A national initiative by the Public Security Directorate / Correction and Rehabilitation Centers Department that enables center residents to showcase and sell their handmade products online — turning their skills into a dignified livelihood and a bridge back into society.
about.hero_photo: Photo — a workshop inside one of the centers
about.video_title: From inside the centers… a story of will
about.video_body: This short film takes you inside Jordan's Reform & Rehabilitation Centers, where residents learn a craft, master it, and turn it into handmade pieces sold through this official store. Behind every product is a person choosing to start over — and every purchase supports their rehabilitation and their journey back into society with dignity and hope.
about.how_title: From skill to your hands in four steps
about.step1_text: Residents learn handcrafts from specialized trainers.
about.step2_text: Every piece is handmade from carefully selected natural materials.
about.step3_text: Products are held to strict standards before going on sale.
about.step4_text: Proceeds go toward empowering makers and reintegrating them.
about.value_trust_text: An official government platform that guarantees the authenticity and provenance of every piece.
about.value_empower_text: Sales proceeds go directly to rehabilitating residents and reintegrating them.
about.value_heritage_text: Authentic Jordanian crafts, handmade to preserve our identity.
about.value_dignity_text: Honest work that rebuilds a person and offers a new beginning.
about.value_quality_text: Strict standards for every product before it reaches your hands.
about.meta_description: Made with Determination — a national initiative enabling residents of correction and rehabilitation centers to sell their handmade crafts online.
